observations: Photo 0: a single loose inline 4-cylinder petrol engine sitting on a wooden floor or bench in a workshop, not in a car.
Photo 0: the silver valve cover carries a Toyota logo and red 'VVT-i' lettering; the small text above it is too blurred to read a displacement or engine code.
Photo 0: intake manifold, throttle body area, front pulleys and what looks like an alternator are attached; the engine is shown from one side only.
Photo 0: the engine is dusty with oily grime and light surface corrosion on the lower block and timing side; it is not clean.
Photo 0: a seller watermark is printed across the engine and the camera stamp reads CAMON 40; only one photo, no engine code, no running clip.

identity.kind: Toyota 4-cylinder VVT-i petrol engine, foreign used, engine code not readable
read_from: photo 0 valve cover: Toyota logo and VVT-i lettering

claims.claim: Direct America (foreign used, imported from the US)
claims.evidence: Nothing in photo 0 shows origin; no import or customs papers.
Photo 0 shows dust, oily grime and surface corrosion on the block and front of the engine.
No clip of the engine running, no compression readings.
A seller promise; nothing in the photo can prove it will be honoured.

risks.risk: Engine code and displacement unknown, which sets the comparables within the Toyota 4-cylinder family
risks.proof: Close, sharp photo of the engine code stamped on the block and the full valve cover text
risks.if_unproven: priced as the cheapest engine in the Toyota 4-cylinder VVT-i family

risks.risk: Engine does not run or has low compression, knocking or burning oil
risks.proof: Clip of the engine running on a stand or in a car with sound, plus a compression test reading per cylinder
risks.if_unproven: as not running, an engine for rebuild

risks.risk: Internal damage such as water in oil or a cracked head
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and of the oil filler cap underside

risks.risk: Accessories missing on the unseen side (starter, sensors, wiring harness, ECU, AC compressor)
risks.proof: Photos of the engine from all four sides and a list of what is included
risks.if_unproven: as a bare long block with only the parts visible in photo 0

proof_requests: Sharp photo of the engine code stamped on the block and the valve cover text
Clip of the engine running with sound, showing the engine code in the same clip
Photos of the other three sides of the engine
Dipstick and oil filler cap photo
Handwritten note with today's date placed on the engine in shot
response.reason: The Toyota logo and VVT-i lettering are readable in photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case as the cheapest Toyota 4-cylinder VVT-i engine, not running, with only the visible parts. The engine code, a running clip and the other sides would raise it.
